patterns.message: AD-1: only src/app (and src/api itself) may import the mock or http adapters. Use the ApiProvider and api/hooks instead.

no-restricted-globals.name: Date
no-restricted-globals.message: AD-9: only src/lib/dates.ts and src/lib/format.ts may use Date. Use lib/dates (toIsoDate, isoDateOf) for dates and lib/format for display.

patterns.message: AD-1: features may import only ui, api and lib.
